name: AgentFlow Pipeline
description: Hotspot → GitHub → data-source pipeline framework. Standalone mode provides webhook/TG notification fallback; OpenClaw Lark App integration requires the official @larksuite/openclaw-lark Feishu channel plugin.

host_root.description: Path to the host project root (cases/, workspaces/, trends/)

auto_promote.description: Enable level-B auto-promote in scheduled scans

lark_integration_mode.description: standalone_webhook uses LARK_WEBHOOK_URL fallback; openclaw_lark_channel delegates Lark App messaging and interactive cards to the official @larksuite/openclaw-lark plugin.

openclaw_lark_plugin.description: Companion OpenClaw Feishu/Lark channel plugin required for Lark App mode.
